purpose: 展示完整七行输入的两行结果、真实迟到提示与退出状态，观察输入结束不补发尚未关闭窗口。
command: go run ./cmd/edgefleet aggregate --window-ms 1000 --slide-ms 600 < sliding.jsonl; rc=$?; echo "exit=$rc"; exit "$rc"

purpose: 展示完整八行延续输入：水位线2200只新增来自时间1700事件的窗口结果，前两行不重发。
command: go run ./cmd/edgefleet aggregate --window-ms 1000 --slide-ms 600 < sliding-continued.jsonl; rc=$?; echo "exit=$rc"; exit "$rc"
